TW=4096;TH=1024;FACE=3840;R=256;LM=22.0;WM=.36
wood_color=np.ones((TH,TW,4),np.float32);wood_normal=np.ones_like(wood_color);wood_normal[:,:,:3]=[.5,.5,1];wood_rough=np.ones_like(wood_color)
wood_finish_roles={'frame':(83,64,47),'cargo_frame':(98,78,57),'trim':(124,103,78),'deck':(128,107,81)}
role_rows={}
def field_into(row,base):
 hh=R-8;ww=FACE-8
 yy,xx=np.mgrid[0:hh,0:ww];l=xx/(ww-1)*LM;t=yy/(hh-1)*WM
 h,tone,dr=old['open_fibers'](l,t,LM,WM,2600+row*17,list(wood_finish_roles)[row])
 # Quiet body grain stays subordinate to the interrupted fibers and end checks.
 grain=np.sin(t*88+.32*np.sin(l*.9))+.35*np.sin(t*183+.6*np.sin(l*.47))
 tone+=grain*2.2;h+=.00012*grain
 rgb=np.clip((np.array(base)+tone[:,:,None]*np.array([1,.87,.68]))/255,0,1)
 gy,gx=np.gradient(h);norms=np.stack([-gx*ww/LM,-gy*hh/WM,np.ones_like(h)],-1);norms/=np.linalg.norm(norms,axis=-1,keepdims=True)
 y=row*R+4;x=4
 wood_color[y:y+hh,x:x+ww,:3]=rgb
 wood_normal[y:y+hh,x:x+ww,:3]=norms*.5+.5
 wood_rough[y:y+hh,x:x+ww,:3]=np.clip(.84+dr+.014*grain,.73,.95)[:,:,None]
 # End grain occupies a separate square, rather than wrapping long grain.
 gy,gx=np.mgrid[0:248,0:248];sx=(gx/247-.47)*WM;sy=(gy/247-.54)*WM
 radius=np.sqrt((sx*1.1)**2+(sy*.86)**2)
 rings=np.sin(radius*190+.4*np.sin(np.arctan2(sy,sx)*4))
 check=np.exp(-((sy-.008*np.sin(sx*24))/.0027)**2)*np.clip((sx+.05)/.13,0,1)
 end_h=.00022*rings-.0015*check;end_tone=4*rings-13*check
 end_rgb=np.clip((np.array(base)+np.array([6,5,3])+end_tone[:,:,None]*np.array([1,.86,.66]))/255,0,1)
 ey,ex=np.gradient(end_h);nn=np.stack([-ex*248/WM,-ey*248/WM,np.ones_like(ex)],-1);nn/=np.linalg.norm(nn,axis=-1,keepdims=True)
 wood_color[y:y+248,FACE+4:FACE+252,:3]=end_rgb;wood_normal[y:y+248,FACE+4:FACE+252,:3]=nn*.5+.5
 wood_rough[y:y+248,FACE+4:FACE+252,:3]=(.89+.015*rings)[:,:,None]
 # Extend edge pixels into all atlas gutters to prevent dark mip seams.
 for arr in [wood_color,wood_normal,wood_rough]:
  arr[row*R:row*R+4,4:FACE-4]=arr[row*R+4,4:FACE-4]
  arr[row*R+252:(row+1)*R,4:FACE-4]=arr[row*R+251,4:FACE-4]
  arr[row*R:(row+1)*R,:4]=arr[row*R:(row+1)*R,4:5]
  arr[row*R:(row+1)*R,FACE-4:FACE]=arr[row*R:(row+1)*R,FACE-5:FACE-4]
  arr[row*R:row*R+4,FACE+4:FACE+252]=arr[row*R+4,FACE+4:FACE+252]
  arr[row*R+252:(row+1)*R,FACE+4:FACE+252]=arr[row*R+251,FACE+4:FACE+252]
  arr[row*R:(row+1)*R,FACE:FACE+4]=arr[row*R:(row+1)*R,FACE+4:FACE+5]
  arr[row*R:(row+1)*R,FACE+252:]=arr[row*R:(row+1)*R,FACE+251:FACE+252]
for row,(role,base) in enumerate(wood_finish_roles.items()):
 role_rows[role]=row;field_into(row,base)
wood_finish_images={}
for suffix,arr in [('albedo',wood_color),('normal',wood_normal),('roughness',wood_rough)]:
 path=out/('HarborCraft_TerminalTimber_'+suffix+'.png');png(path,arr)
 im=bpy.data.images.load(str(path),check_existing=False);im.colorspace_settings.name='sRGB' if suffix=='albedo' else 'Non-Color';im.pack();wood_finish_images[suffix]=im
wood_finish_materials={}
for role in role_rows:
 mat=wood[role].copy();mat.name='HarborCraft_TerminalTimber_'+role
 for node in mat.node_tree.nodes:
  if node.type=='TEX_IMAGE' and node.image:
   for suffix,im in wood_finish_images.items():
    if suffix in node.image.name:node.image=im;break
 wood_finish_materials[role]=mat
def finish_timber_uv(ob,role):
 row=role_rows[role];uv=ob.data.uv_layers[0];vs=np.array([tuple(v.co) for v in ob.data.vertices]);lo=vs.min(0);span=vs.max(0)-lo
 seed=sum((j+2)*ord(ch) for j,ch in enumerate(ob.name));shift=(LM-span[0])*(seed%97)/97
 ob.data.materials.clear();ob.data.materials.append(wood_finish_materials[role])
 for poly in ob.data.polygons:
  axis=int(np.argmax(np.abs(poly.normal[:])))
  for li in poly.loop_indices:
   p=ob.data.vertices[ob.data.loops[li].vertex_index].co
   if axis==0:
    a=(p[1]-lo[1])/WM;b=(p[2]-lo[2])/WM
    uv.data[li].uv=((FACE+4+a*247)/TW,(row*R+4+b*247)/TH)
   else:
    other=1 if axis==2 else 2
    uv.data[li].uv=((4+(p[0]-lo[0]+shift)/LM*(FACE-9))/TW,(row*R+4+(p[other]-lo[other])/WM*247)/TH)
wood_count=0
for ob in c.objects:
 if ob.type!='MESH' or not ob.data.uv_layers or ob.data.uv_layers[0].name!='TerminalTimberUV':continue

 if role:finish_timber_uv(ob,role);wood_count+=1

 role='trim';row=role_rows[role];uv=ob.data.uv_layers[0];arcs=[0]
 pts=[sum((ob.data.vertices[k+j].co for j in range(4)),Vector())/4 for k in range(0,len(ob.data.vertices),4)]
 for j in range(1,len(pts)):arcs.append(arcs[-1]+(pts[j]-pts[j-1]).length)
 shift=(LM-arcs[-1])*.31
 ob.data.materials.clear();ob.data.materials.append(wood_finish_materials[role])
 for poly in ob.data.polygons:
  stations={ob.data.loops[li].vertex_index//4 for li in poly.loop_indices}
  for li in poly.loop_indices:
   index=ob.data.loops[li].vertex_index;station,corner=divmod(index,4)
   if len(stations)==1:
    a=[0,0,.17,.17][corner];b=[0,.146,.146,0][corner]
    uv.data[li].uv=((FACE+4+a/WM*247)/TW,(row*R+4+b/WM*247)/TH)
   else:
    across=[0,.146,.146,0][corner] if abs(poly.normal.y)>.6 else [0,0,.17,.17][corner]
    uv.data[li].uv=((4+(arcs[station]+shift)/LM*(FACE-9))/TW,(row*R+4+across/WM*247)/TH)
# Slate relief is restrained after the first real camera comparison.
for kind,strength in [('Slate',.43),('Stone',.75)]:
 for node in mineral_materials[kind][0].node_tree.nodes:
